about: The dealer's pattern of movement, written by verktyg/monster.py from the measurements of verktyg/mat.py. Lengths in shoulder widths of the dealer in the picture (unit_px) unless a name ends in _px; times in seconds of the film; L and R are the dealer's own left and right; pixels are those of the table picture (data/kalla.json). turn plus is the head turned toward the picture's side given in head_turn_plus.
